mainText: <speak><voice name="Ivy">Hello, Verona! At 1 AM, we are looking at clear skies and a current temperature of 77 degrees near Verona City Hall under a beautiful full moon.</voice></speak>

<speak><voice name="Joanna">The City of Verona is inviting students to design the new I Voted sticker for the upcoming election, with submissions closing soon. Additionally, residents interested in the free tri-shaw program at the Senior Center must complete a waiver and release form to participate.</voice></speak>

<speak><voice name="Matthew">We have a packed schedule of fun today and tomorrow, including trivia at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, and Paddy Mac's, plus live music and yoga sessions happening tomorrow.</voice></speak>

<speak><voice name="Justin">In a noteworthy call for service on Monday, July 20, a VPD drone officer assisted the Dane County Sheriff's Office in locating an individual who fled a residence in the Town of Springdale.</voice></speak>
<speak><voice name="Joey">Today is the day to enjoy the Georgia Peach flavor of the day. The shop is currently closed, but they will be ready to serve you starting at 10 AM.</voice></speak>
